# Hyperallergic

> > Independent art journalism covering contemporary art, exhibitions, cultural commentary, and art world news since 2009.

Founded by Hrag Vartanian, Hyperallergic provides critical coverage of the art world including major exhibitions like the Whitney Biennial, museum news, artist profiles, and opinion pieces on art criticism, equity, and cultural issues. The publication operates through reader support and offers daily newsletters, artist opportunities, and submission guidelines for contributors.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary Art
- Art Criticism
- Whitney Biennial
- Independent Journalism
- Exhibition Reviews
- Cultural Commentary

- Public Art
- Los Angeles Art Scene
- MoMA
- Guggenheim

- Paid Membership

## About & Getting Started

- [Hyperallergic](https://hyperallergic.com): Homepage featuring Whitney Biennial, LA art shows, and latest art news
- [About](https://hyperallergic.com/about): About page detailing Hyperallergic's founding by Gueyikian & Vartanian
- [Welcome to Hyperallergic](https://hyperallergic.com/welcome): Welcome page introducing Hyperallergic's mission since 2009
- [Newsletters](https://hyperallergic.com/newsletters): Newsletter hub featuring daily and weekly art news digests

## Latest News & Featured Articles

- [Latest](https://hyperallergic.com/latest): Latest news featuring Thaddeus Mosley, Amoako Boafo, and Whitney Biennial
- [First Impressions From the 2026 Whitney Biennial](https://hyperallergic.com/first-impressions-from-the-2026-whitney-biennial): Early review of 2026 Whitney Biennial curated by Guerrero and Sawyer
- [Best Art in Worst of Times](https://hyperallergic.com/12-20-25-weekly-2): Weekly newsletter covering best art of 2025 and independent journalism
- [Required Reading](https://hyperallergic.com/required-reading-734): Weekly roundup featuring Mona Chalabi on hijab animation and more

## Art Criticism & Cultural Commentary

- [The Fabricated Crisis of Art Criticism](https://hyperallergic.com/1012944/the-fabricated-crisis-of-art-criticism): Opinion piece challenging the 'art criticism in crisis' narrative
- [What the Data Tell Us About the Challenges Facing Female Artists of Color](https://hyperallergic.com/what-the-data-tell-us-about-the-challenges-facing-female-artists-of-color): Data-driven analysis of gender and racial inequality in art world
- [Issues of Intimacy, Distance, and Disavowal in Writing About Deana Lawson's Work](https://hyperallergic.com/issues-of-intimacy-distance-and-disavowal-in-writing-about-deana-lawsons-work): Essay on editorial censorship and Deana Lawson photography critique
- [San Francisco's Tech Billionaires Don't Care About Your Art School](https://hyperallergic.com/san-franciscos-tech-oligrachs-dont-care-about-your-art-school): Opinion on California College of Arts closure and tech wealth disparity
- [Why Are We Paying for the Privilege of Rejection?](https://hyperallergic.com/why-are-we-paying-for-the-privilege-of-rejection): Opinion on application fees as barriers to artist opportunities

## Artist Features & Profiles

- [Aline Manoukian and the Specter of War Photography](https://hyperallergic.com/1002521/aline-manoukian-and-the-specter-of-war-photography): Profile of photojournalist Aline Manoukian's Lebanese Civil War work
- [A View From the Easel](https://hyperallergic.com/a-view-from-the-easel-240): Artist studio series featuring workspace reflections and creative process
- [The Tender Art of 'Visible Mending'](https://hyperallergic.com/the-tender-art-of-visible-mending): Feature on Repair Shop's visible mending practice and sustainable fashion
- [The Japanese American National Museum Is a Site of Remembrance and Belonging](https://hyperallergic.com/japanese-american-national-museum-site-of-remembrance-belonging): Sponsored feature on JANM and WWII Japanese-American incarceration history

## Art Techniques & Tutorials

- [An Animated Guide to the Bronze Age Technique of Lost-Wax Casting](https://hyperallergic.com/an-animated-guide-to-the-bronze-age-technique-of-lost-wax-casting): Animated tutorial on ancient lost-wax bronze casting technique
- [A Step-by-Step Guide to Making an Illuminated Manuscript](https://hyperallergic.com/a-step-by-step-guide-to-making-an-illuminated-manuscript): Tutorial on medieval manuscript-making using Morgan Library's collection
- [An Open-Source Guide to Help You Build Your Own Graffiti Drone](https://hyperallergic.com/an-open-source-guide-to-help-you-build-your-own-graffiti-drone): Open-source guide to Katsu's Icarus One spray-painting drone
- [A Handy Beginner's Guide to Urban Light Projection](https://hyperallergic.com/230212/a-handy-beginners-guide-to-urban-light-projection): Manual for Urban Projection guide to public light projection activism
- [Draw Lifelike Faces with a Free Guide Exclusively from Craftsy](https://hyperallergic.com/draw-lifelike-faces-with-a-free-guide-exclusively-from-craftsy): Free Craftsy guide to drawing human faces with step-by-step tutorials
